privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: You can enable or disable error reporting at any time.
privacy.telemetryHint: Automatically sends a report to Sentry when the app crashes, to help us fix bugs.
privacy.includedTitle: What gets sent on a crash
included: The error message and the call stack.
The version of ExtrAct and of your system.
A handful of actions performed just before the crash.
excluded: The contents of your PDFs, your transcriptions, your fields.
Your IP address, your username, your file paths.
privacy.note: Note: ExtrAct sends your PDF zones to OpenAI or Anthropic during transcription — that's how the app works. This option only governs the error reports we use to fix bugs.
privacy.recipient: <bold>Recipient:</bold> Sentry, servers in Germany (EU, GDPR). The change takes effect on the next app restart.
